China Faces Allegations of Election Interference and Tech Competition

Former US President Donald Trump has accused China of acquiring US voter data and meddling in the 2020 election. China has rejected these allegations as baseless. Meanwhile, China is also making strides in AI technology and reusable rocket development, positioning itself as a competitor to US tech dominance and seeking to influence the global order.
